title: Unlocking the potential of internal Li-ion transfer in Ni-rich cathodes blended with LiFePO4 to address first cycle irreversible capacity loss and degradation
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,7950-7966
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00404G, Paper
Myoungsoo Kang, Seheon Oh, Kangwoo Ahn, Hyun Woo Kim, Jin Bae Lee, Jeongsik Yun, Minkyu Kim
We propose a strategy to mitigate both the initial capacity loss and long-term capacity degradation in Ni-rich cathodes by leveraging internal Li-ion transfer through blending with LiFePO4.
